result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional `description`, and it comes back in all the listings you named plus the lookup by code. The promotion tests pass (`PromotionTest`, `PromotionUsageTest`, `PromotionsPerRegionTest`, `PromotionsPerCustomerTest`, `OrderPromotionTest`, `PriceListTest`, 26 tests, 0 failures). I did not run the full suite.

What changed:
- **`src/main/resources/schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component, null when a promotion has none.
- **`PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A null or blank description is stored as null, the same way blank categories are handled. The existing 5-argument method delegates to it with no description, so the ~50 existing call sites are untouched.
- **`PromotionStore.java`**: the shared `SELECT_PROMOTION` now selects `p.description`, and `create` inserts it. Every listing and `findByCode` go through this select, so they all return it.
- **`Rows.java`**: the row mapper reads `description`.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `returnsDescriptionInEveryListing` test. It checks the SUMMER description through `findByCode`, `listActive` (date and region), `listByCategory`, `listUnused`, and `findBest`, and checks that a promotion created without one has none.

Nothing is committed. The untracked `.claude/` directory was already there before I started and I left it alone.
